## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
clonality_res_pc <- clonality_res[clonality_res$gene %in% prostate_genes, ] 
```

```{r}
clonality_df <- clonality_res_pc %>%
  mutate(
    alteration = case_when(
      event_type == "SNV" ~ "MUTATION",

      total_cn >= 6 ~ "AMP",
      total_cn >= 4 ~ "PARTIAL_AMP",

      total_cn == 0 ~ "DEL",
      total_cn <= 1 ~ "DEL",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
driver_clonality <- clonality_df %>%
  inner_join(
    drivers_allIDs,
    by = c(
      "hmfPatientId",
      "gene",
      "alteration"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
pat_summary_pc <- clonality_res_all_pc %>%
  group_by(hmfPatientId, group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_events = n(),
    n_subclonal = sum(clonality < 0.85),
    prop_subclonal = n_subclonal / n_events
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

gene_order <- driver_clonality %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(median_clonality = median(clonality, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_clonality)) %>%
  pull(gene)

driver_clonality$gene <- factor(driver_clonality$gene, levels = gene_order)

# remove partial amp
driver_clonality <- driver_clonality[driver_clonality$alteration != "PARTIAL_AMP", ]

ggplot(driver_clonality,
       aes(x = reorder(gene, clonality, FUN = mean),
           y = clonality,
           fill = alteration)) +
 # geom_violin(position = "identity", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = alteration),
              width = 0.2, alpha = 0.3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_reverse()
```

```{r}
# patient-wise RB1 vs TP53
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

pat_clon <- driver_clonality %>%
  mutate(
    RB1_TP53_status = case_when(
      hmfPatientId %in% RB1_pats & hmfPatientId %in% TP53_pats ~ "RB1+TP53",
      hmfPatientId %in% RB1_pats ~ "RB1",
      hmfPatientId %in% TP53_pats ~ "TP53",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(RB1_TP53_status)) %>%
  group_by(hmfPatientId, RB1_TP53_status) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_clonality = mean(clonality, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_clonality = median(clonality, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_subclonal = mean(clonality < 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_events = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(pat_clon, aes(x = RB1_TP53_status, y = prop_subclonal)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "grey90", alpha = 0.8, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion subclonal per patient",
    title = "Patient-wise subclonality in RB1 vs TP53 altered tumours"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

# MAIN PLOT 2
ggplot(pat_clon, aes(x = RB1_TP53_status, y = prop_subclonal)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = RB1_TP53_status), alpha = 0.6, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = RB1_TP53_status), width = 0.12, alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "RB1" = "#1f78b4",
    "TP53" = "#e31a1c",
    "RB1+TP53" = "#6a3d9a"
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "RB1" = "#1f78b4",
    "TP53" = "#e31a1c",
    "RB1+TP53" = "#6a3d9a"
  )) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion subclonal per patient",
    title = "Patient-wise subclonality in RB1 vs TP53 altered tumours"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

There is a cler difference between subclonality in HRD vs HRP but most atients in both groups still have mostly clonal alterations. So how can we figure out what makes a tumour have subclonal alterations?

```{r}
## separate clonal and subclonal 

driver_clonality <- driver_clonality %>%
  mutate(TP53_status = ifelse(hmfPatientId %in% TP53_pats, "alt", "wt"))

meta_purity <- metadata[, c(2,4)]

driver_clonality <- left_join(driver_clonality, meta_purity, by = "hmfPatientId")
```

```{r}
driver_clonality <- driver_clonality %>%
  mutate(
    purity_group = case_when(
      tumorPurity < 0.5 ~ "Low (<0.5)",
      tumorPurity < 0.7 ~ "Medium (0.5–0.7)",
      TRUE ~ "High (>0.7)"
    )
  )

ggplot(driver_clonality,
       aes(x = clonality, y = gene, color = alteration)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(purity_group ~ hr_status) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
## has subclonal

pat_level <- driver_clonality %>%
  group_by(hmfPatientId) %>%
  summarise(
    has_subclonal = any(clonality < 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_subclonal = mean(clonality < 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
    tumorPurity = first(tumorPurity),
    hr_status = first(hr_status),
    TP53_status = first(TP53_status),
    RB1_status = first(RB1_status),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

library(logistf)

pat_level <- pat_level %>%
  mutate(
    has_subclonal = factor(has_subclonal,
                           levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
                           labels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )

model_firth <- logistf(
  has_subclonal ~ hr_status + TP53_status,
  data = pat_level
)

## does HRD suppress subclonality even when TP53 is altered
logistf(
  has_subclonal ~ hr_status * TP53_status + tumorPurity,
  data = pat_level
)
```

```{r}
library(ggeffects)


pred <- ggpredict(model_firth, terms = c("hr_status", "TP53_status"))

plot(pred)
```

```{r}
## can we show that even in the presence of TP53 or RB1 alterations HRD are still clonally restricted?


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# make sure the grouping column exists
pat_plot <- pat_level %>%
  mutate(
    group_TP53 = case_when(
      hr_status == "HRD" & TP53_status == "wt"  ~ "HRD / TP53 wt",
      hr_status == "HRD" & TP53_status == "alt" ~ "HRD / TP53 altered",
      hr_status == "HRP" & TP53_status == "wt"  ~ "HRP / TP53 wt",
      hr_status == "HRP" & TP53_status == "alt" ~ "HRP / TP53 altered"
    ),
    group_TP53 = factor(
      group_TP53,
      levels = c(
        "HRD / TP53 wt",
        "HRD / TP53 altered",
        "HRP / TP53 wt",
        "HRP / TP53 altered"
      )
    )
  )

# colours
fill_cols <- c(
  "HRD / TP53 wt" = "#4F81BD",
  "HRD / TP53 altered" = "#7EA6E0",
  "HRP / TP53 wt" = "#F4A259",
  "HRP / TP53 altered" = "#D95F5F"
)

line_cols <- c(
  "HRD / TP53 wt" = "#163A8C",
  "HRD / TP53 altered" = "#4F81BD",
  "HRP / TP53 wt" = "#E66A00",
  "HRP / TP53 altered" = "#C62828"
)

# sample sizes for axis labels
group_counts <- table(pat_plot$group_TP53)

group_labels <- paste0(
  names(group_counts),
  "\n(n = ", group_counts, ")"
)

names(group_labels) <- names(group_counts)

ggplot(pat_plot, aes(x = group_TP53, y = prop_subclonal)) +
  # boxplot
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = group_TP53, colour = group_TP53),
    width = 0.42,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.22,
    size = 0.8
  ) +
  
  # jittered points
  geom_jitter(
    aes(colour = group_TP53),
    width = 0.14,
    height = 0,
    alpha = 0.75,
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  # mean point
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    colour = "black",
    fill = "black",
    shape = 21,
    size = 3.8
  ) +
  
  # mean +/- normal CI
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_normal,
    geom = "errorbar",
    colour = "black",
    width = 0.10,
    size = 0.7
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_cols) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = line_cols) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = group_counts) +
  
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.02), clip = "off") +
  
  labs(
    #title = "HRD tumours remain clonally restricted even when TP53 is altered",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of subclonal alterations"
  ) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(labels = group_labels) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 18,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 12,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.8),
    axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.8)
  )
```

```{r}
# treatment
meta_tx_timing <- meta_full[, c(2,12,18)]
names(meta_tx_timing)[c(2,3)] <- c("biopsyDate", "treatmentStartDate")
meta_tx_timing <- meta_tx_timing[-c(1:10),]

meta_tx_timing$biopsy2tx <- as.Date(meta_tx_timing$biopsyDate) - as.Date(meta_tx_timing$treatmentStartDate)

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

meta_tx_timing <- meta_tx_timing %>%
  mutate(
    biopsy2tx = str_remove(biopsy2tx, " days"),
    biopsy2tx = as.integer(biopsy2tx)
  )

# group timing between biopsy and treratment
meta_tx_timing <- meta_tx_timing %>%
  mutate(
    tx_timing_group = case_when(
      is.na(biopsy2tx) ~ NA_character_,
      biopsy2tx < 1 ~ "Pre-treatment",
#      biopsy2tx >= -60 & biopsy2tx < -14 ~ "Pre-treatment (near)",
      biopsy2tx >= 1 & biopsy2tx <= 14 ~ "Peri-treatment",
      biopsy2tx > 14 & biopsy2tx <= 90 ~ "Early post-treatment",
      biopsy2tx > 90 ~ "Late post-treatment"
    )
  )

driver_clonality_tx <- left_join(
  driver_clonality, meta_tx_timing,
  by = "hmfPatientId"
)

ggplot(driver_clonality_tx,
       aes(x = gene,
           y = clonality,
           color = tx_timing_group)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  facet_wrap(~ hr_status, ncol = 1)

lm(clonality ~ tx_timing_group * hr_status + tumorPurity,
    data = driver_clonality_tx)
```

```{r}
## patient-level
patient_clonality_tx <- driver_clonality_tx %>%
  group_by(hmfPatientId, tx_timing_group, hr_status) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_clonality = mean(clonality, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_subclonal = mean(clonality < 0.85, na.rm = TRUE),
    tumorPurity = first(tumorPurity)
  )

lm(mean_clonality ~ tx_timing_group * hr_status + tumorPurity,
   data = patient_clonality_tx)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

patient_clonality_tx <- patient_clonality_tx %>%
  mutate(
    tx_timing_group = factor(
      tx_timing_group,
      levels = c("Pre-treatment", "Peri-treatment", "Late post-treatment")
    )
  )

library(ggeffects)

patient_clonality_tx <- patient_clonality_tx %>%
  mutate(mean_subclonality = 1 - mean_clonality)

fit <- lm(mean_subclonality ~ tx_timing_group * hr_status + tumorPurity,
          data = patient_clonality_tx)

pred <- ggpredict(fit, terms = c("tx_timing_group", "hr_status"))

ggplot(pred, aes(x = x, y = predicted, colour = group, group = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.1) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(
  ymin = conf.low,
  ymax = pmin(conf.high, 1)
), width = 0.1) +
  labs(
    x = "Timing of biopsy relative to treatment start",
    y = "Adjusted mean clonality",
    colour = "HR status"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

HRD specifically constrains **SNV-based subclonal diversification**, while CNV dynamics remain comparable across groups

```{r}
summary(fit_binom)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(stringr)

clonal_cutoff <- 0.85

ev_pc <- clonality_res_all_pcSNV %>%
  mutate(
    subclonal = clonality < clonal_cutoff,
    gene = toupper(gene)
  )


## add pathway
pathmap2 <- pathmap %>%
  transmute(
    gene = toupper(gene),
    pathway = pathway
  ) %>%
  distinct()

ev_pc <- ev_pc %>%
  left_join(pathmap2, by = "gene")
```

For each patient-gene pair, ask: did this patient have that gene subclonally altered at least once?

```{r}
gene_patient <- ev_pc %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "") %>%
  group_by(hmfPatientId, group, gene) %>%
  summarise(
    has_subclonal_gene = any(subclonal, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_subclonal_gene_events = sum(subclonal, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# summarise to group level
gene_group_summary <- gene_patient %>%
  group_by(group, gene) %>%
  summarise(
    n_patients_with_subclonal = sum(has_subclonal_gene),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

group_sizes <- ev_pc %>%
  distinct(hmfPatientId, group) %>%
  count(group, name = "n_patients")

gene_group_summary <- gene_group_summary %>%
  left_join(group_sizes, by = "group") %>%
  mutate(prop_patients_subclonal = n_patients_with_subclonal / n_patients)

# get present in HRp/TP53 and not in HRD
gene_wide <- gene_group_summary %>%
  select(group, gene, prop_patients_subclonal, n_patients_with_subclonal) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = group,
    values_from = c(prop_patients_subclonal, n_patients_with_subclonal),
    values_fill = 0
  )

gene_candidates <- gene_wide %>%
  mutate(
    enrich_vs_hrd_hrp  = prop_patients_subclonal_HRP  - prop_patients_subclonal_HRD,
    enrich_vs_hrd_tp53 = prop_patients_subclonal_TP53 - prop_patients_subclonal_HRD,
    mean_nonhrd = (prop_patients_subclonal_HRP + prop_patients_subclonal_TP53) / 2,
    contrast_score = mean_nonhrd - prop_patients_subclonal_HRD
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(contrast_score))

gene_candidates_strict <- gene_candidates %>%
  filter(
    prop_patients_subclonal_HRD == 0,
    (prop_patients_subclonal_HRP >= 0.05 | prop_patients_subclonal_TP53 >= 0.05)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(contrast_score))

## plot
top_genes <- gene_candidates %>%
  slice_max(order_by = contrast_score, n = 20)

plot_dat_gene <- gene_group_summary %>%
  semi_join(top_genes, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(gene = fct_reorder(gene, prop_patients_subclonal, .fun = max))

ggplot(plot_dat_gene, aes(x = gene, y = prop_patients_subclonal, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of patients with subclonal alteration",
    title = "Genes subclonally altered in HRP/TP53 but rare or absent in HRD"
  )
```

```{r}
## pathway level
pathway_patient <- ev_pc %>%
  filter(!is.na(pathway), pathway != "") %>%
  group_by(hmfPatientId, group, pathway) %>%
  summarise(
    has_subclonal_pathway = any(subclonal, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_subclonal_pathway_events = sum(subclonal, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pathway_group_summary <- pathway_patient %>%
  group_by(group, pathway) %>%
  summarise(
    n_patients_with_subclonal = sum(has_subclonal_pathway),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(group_sizes, by = "group") %>%
  mutate(prop_patients_subclonal = n_patients_with_subclonal / n_patients)

pathway_wide <- pathway_group_summary %>%
  select(group, pathway, prop_patients_subclonal, n_patients_with_subclonal) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = group,
    values_from = c(prop_patients_subclonal, n_patients_with_subclonal),
    values_fill = 0
  )

pathway_candidates <- pathway_wide %>%
  mutate(
    mean_nonhrd = (prop_patients_subclonal_HRP + prop_patients_subclonal_TP53) / 2,
    contrast_score = mean_nonhrd - prop_patients_subclonal_HRD
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(contrast_score))

top_pathways <- pathway_candidates %>%
  filter(
    prop_patients_subclonal_HRD == 0,
    (prop_patients_subclonal_HRP >= 0.05 | prop_patients_subclonal_TP53 >= 0.05)
  ) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = contrast_score, n = 15)

plot_dat_pathway <- pathway_group_summary %>%
  semi_join(top_pathways, by = "pathway") %>%
  mutate(pathway = fct_reorder(pathway, prop_patients_subclonal, .fun = max))

ggplot(plot_dat_pathway, aes(x = pathway, y = prop_patients_subclonal, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of patients with subclonal pathway alteration",
    title = "Pathways with subclonal alterations in HRP/TP53 but not HRD")
```

```{r}
  distinct(hmfPatientId, group)

all_genes <- ev_pc %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "") %>%
  distinct(gene)

gene_patient_full <- tidyr::crossing(all_patients, all_genes) %>%
  left_join(gene_patient, by = c("hmfPatientId", "group", "gene")) %>%
  mutate(
    has_subclonal_gene = ifelse(is.na(has_subclonal_gene), FALSE, has_subclonal_gene))
```

![](images/clipboard-1460078602.png)

```{r}

## HRD vs nonHRD
gene_fisher <- gene_patient_full %>%
  mutate(nonhrd = ifelse(group == "HRD", "HRD", "nonHRD")) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    hrd_yes    = sum(has_subclonal_gene & nonhrd == "HRD"),
    hrd_no     = sum(!has_subclonal_gene & nonhrd == "HRD"),
    nonhrd_yes = sum(has_subclonal_gene & nonhrd == "nonHRD"),
    nonhrd_no  = sum(!has_subclonal_gene & nonhrd == "nonHRD"),
    p_value = fisher.test(matrix(
      c(hrd_yes, hrd_no, nonhrd_yes, nonhrd_no),
      nrow = 2
    ))$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    padj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  left_join(gene_candidates, by = "gene") %>%
  arrange(padj, desc(contrast_score))

gene_fisher %>%
  select(
    gene, hrd_yes, nonhrd_yes, p_value, padj,
    starts_with("prop_patients_subclonal"),
    contrast_score
  ) %>%
  head(30)
```

HRD shows a broad reduction in subclonal burden, rather than a strongly gene-specific depletion signal detectable one gene at a time.

HRD tumours are not globally less evolutionary, but specifically exhibit reduced ongoing SNV-driven diversification, consistent with an early mutational burst followed by constrained evolutionary branching.

HRD may actually have *lower probability* of SNV subclonality

```{r}

```

HRD tumours show reduced SNV-driven subclonal evolution, both in the probability of harbouring subclonal mutations and in their extent, while CNV subclonality remains comparatively similar across groups.

HRD constrains SNV diversification at multiple levels (initiation and expansion), while leaving CNV dynamics largely intact.

Take-home

HRD tumours exhibit a marked reduction in SNV-based subclonal evolution—both in the likelihood of subclonal mutations and their accumulation—while CNV subclonality remains largely comparable across groups.

HRD tumours look genomically chaotic, but evolutionarily simple—most of the damage happens early and gets locked in

Before we go any further though, we need to check if the differences in subclonality between HRD and TP53 hold when we control for TP53 alterations as several of the HRD patients have an alteration in TP53

```{r}
  c("HRD", "HRP"),
```

```{r}
pat_summary_pcCNV_plot <- pat_summary_pcCNV %>%
```

New approach:

gene-level clonality → patient-level evolutionary phenotype → back to gene drivers

```{r}
library(dplyr)

patient_clonality <- pat_clonality_all_filt %>%
  group_by(hmfPatientId) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_subclonal = sum(has_subclonal, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(n_events, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_clonal    = sum(has_clonal, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(n_events, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_clonality = weighted.mean(mean_clonality, w = n_events, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_events_total = sum(n_events, na.rm = TRUE),
    tumorPurity    = first(tumorPurity),
    tx_class       = first(tx_class),
    group          = first(group)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

What determines whether genomic instability leads to clonal fixation vs ongoing diversification?

```{r}
patient_clonality <- patient_clonality %>%
  mutate(
    evolution_mode = case_when(
      prop_subclonal == 0 & n_events_total < 10000 ~ "Stable_clonal",
      prop_subclonal == 0 & n_events_total >= 10000 ~ "Genomically_unstable_clonal",
      prop_subclonal > 0 ~ "Subclonal_evolution"
    )
  )

patient_clonality %>%
  arrange(n_events_total) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rank, y = n_events_total, color = evolution_mode)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic()
```

Event burden and subclonality are correlated, but not deterministically

Low events → almost always clonal

Very high events → often subclonal

But: some very high-event tumours remain **clonally fixed**

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

patient_level <- pat_gene_clon %>%
  distinct(hmfPatientId, prop_subclonal, n_events_total, tumorPurity, residual_subclonality)

ggplot(pat_gene_clon, aes(x = patient_rank, y = prop_subclonal)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Patients ranked by subclonality",
    y = "Proportion subclonal",
    title = "Patient-wise tumour subclonality spectrum"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(pat_gene_clon, aes(x = tumorPurity, y = prop_subclonal)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Tumour purity",
    y = "Proportion subclonal",
   title = "Relationship between tumour purity and subclonality"
  )
```
